note: What a Map16 TILE is, by tileset, for the editor's readouts.
Keys are hex Map16 tile numbers. Each carries `actAsTilesets`: a description per FG tileset
id (hex, 0-F) plus `all`, the description for every tileset not named — a tileset's own
entry overrides `all`. Tiles 000-0FF are shared by every tileset, so they only need `all`;
100-1FF change with the tileset, so they take one line per tileset they differ in.
Hand-edited. A tile without an entry describes as nothing rather than as a guess.
